Bionic.description:
A part fitted in place of the player's own: a grade of the power cell, the legs or the
feet, the datajack or the eye.
Bionic.title: Bionic

InteractableKind.description:
What it is. A `plug` charges the player's lamp while they stand on one of its stand tiles.
A `jack` is a machine only the datajack works, such as the metro's dead terminal and its lift:
without one it's dead, and a link ending on one of its stand tiles can't be taken. A
`searchable` is a piece of furniture or a dead appliance, searched once for what it holds.
InteractableKind.title: InteractableKind

id.description: What it is, the same for every one of its kind, e.g. "copper_wire" or "lamp". Salvage is priced by it.
id.title: Id

name.description: What the player sees, e.g. "Copper wire".
name.title: Name

weight.description: In kg, counted against the carry limit.
weight.title: Weight

charge.description: A lamp's battery, from 0 (flat) to 1 (full). It runs down while the lamp is on, and at a plug it charges, on or off. Null for anything else.
charge.title: Charge

on.description: Whether a lamp is switched on, running its battery down. The player switches it, and it goes off by itself when it's flat. Null for anything else.
on.title: On

ItemKind.description: What it's for: `salvage` to sell, `food` to eat, the `lamp` to see by, or a `part` to fit.
ItemKind.title: ItemKind

Tile.description:
A cell of the map grid, about 1.1 m across, counted in tiles from the top-left corner. On a
side-view map, x runs along the street and y counts rows down from the top, and a resident
stands on a cell with ground under it or on a climbable cell.
Tile.title: Tile

TileArea.description:
A rectangle of tiles, from its top-left tile (x, y). On a side-view map, x runs along the
street and y counts rows down from the top.
TileArea.title: TileArea

description:
Something on an interior's map that you can use, from one of its stand tiles. A searchable
thing is searched once for the `items` and `money` it holds and the recipe it `teaches`, and so
is a jack that holds or teaches anything, with the datajack. The player's `searched` says
whether it has been.

stand.description: The tiles you use it from, on the same map.
stand.title: Stand

items.description: What searching it finds, in order: a searchable's, or a jack's. Left out while it holds nothing.
items.title: Items

money.description: Cash searching it finds, which weighs nothing: a searchable's, or a jack's. Left out while there's none.
money.title: Money

teaches.description: The recipe searching it teaches, by the bionic it builds, such as Aris's schematic for the datajack: a searchable's, or a jack's. Left out while it teaches none.

title: Interactable
